As such, the MDA1 is ideal for connecting instruments with passive pickups, which have very high impedances, by preserving the top end of the instrument's frequency response. The MDA1's balanced output provides a clean signal that is less susceptible to noise than an unbalanced line, allowing for longer cable runs. In addition, a 2-position 0dB/-15dB attenuation switch lets you adapt the MDA1 to a wide variety of signals. Thru JackThe MDA1's Thru jack enables you to tap off the signal from the input and pass the signal to an amplifier or monitor without affecting the original audio. This can eliminate the need for miking guitar amplifiers, which depending on your application may be preferable, especially as more musicians are using in-ear monitors. Roadworthy ConstructionHoused in a 14-gauge steel chassis, the MDA1 is built to withstand the abuse of the most demanding live tours. Product Performance:
This product is a systemic herbicide formulated with Niclosulfuron and Isoxaflutole, designed for the control of annual weeds in corn fields. It can be absorbed by the stems, leaves, and roots of weeds and translocated within the plant, providing fast weed control with safety for subsequent crops.Scope of Use and Application Method:
Corn Fields: 1200-1500 mL/ha
100 mL/kmÂ²Technical Requirements for Use:
This product is intended for use in corn fields during the 3-5 leaf stage of corn seedlings and the 2-4 leaf stage of weeds, with a maximum application frequency of once per season.Precautions:Before preparing the solution, thoroughly shake the bottle, and after mixing, use immediately. To avoid phytotoxicity, do not apply the herbicide repeatedly.Do not mix with organophosphate insecticides. Do not use organophosphate insecticides within 7 days of using this product to prevent phytotoxicity. Avoid mixing with alkaline pesticides, and do not mix with fertilizers or seeds to prevent cross-contamination.Cultivating the soil within one week after application may affect weed control effectiveness. Rain within the week after application may impact effectiveness, but if rain occurs 6 hours after application, it will not affect efficacy, and reapplication is unnecessary. Exercise caution under special conditions such as high temperatures, dry conditions, low temperatures, or weak corn growth.Do not use this product in corn fields or broadleaf crops that were previously treated with long-lasting residual herbicides such as Metsulfuron, Chlorsulfuron, etc., during the previous wheat crop.Strictly follow the label instructions and technical information for the use of this product. 3703325432.title: Noli Me Tangere Novel - for High School and College Students Filipino Text Full Version
3703325432.description:
Written by Jose Rizal
Translared by Virgilio S. Almario

1999 National Book Award for Best Translation

Natapos sulatin ni Jose Rizal ang Noli Me Tangere noong Pebrero 21, 1887 sa Berlin at lumabas sa limbagan pagkaraan nang mahigit isang buwan. Noong Agosto 30 sa taon ding iyon, ipinagbawal sa Filipinas ang pag-aari at pagbasa sa naturang nobela, alinsunod sa batas ng Arsobispo ng Maynila. Kinumpirma ng lupon sa sensura ang pagbabawal dahil tahasan itong tumutuligsa, diumano, sa relihiyon ng mga estado, mga institusyon, at mga kagalang-galang na tao sa FIlipinas sa panahon ng kolonyalismong Espanyol bukod sa hitik ito sa mga "kaisipang banyaga" na maaaring pumukaw ng poot laban sa Espanya. Hindi makatarungan ang pagbabawal. Ngunit tama ang mga awtoridad dahil kasama ng karugtong na nobelang El Filibusterismo ay pinatunayan ng kasaysayan ang bisa ng panulat ni Rizal sa pagkamulat ng mga FIlipino. Makalipas ng ilang taon, sumiklab ang Himagsikang Filipino na tumapos sa mahabang pananakop ng mga Espanyol. Dinadakila ngayon ang mga nobela ni Rizal bilang matalim na pagsusuri sa lipunang kolonyal at feudal at bilang huwaran ng malikhain at realistang pagsulat nang may kalakip na mithiing pampolitika.
